title: Bounce & Draw
description: Draw the walls, let the balls pay you. A ball falls down a dark board; draw a bar anywhere and it becomes something solid to ricochet off, and every bounce earns. The whole game is one honest idea — a bounce is worth money, so you are really building a machine that maximises bounces. A funnel. A staircase. A long shallow ramp that keeps a ball skimming instead of dropping. Every bar is also a note: its pitch comes from its length, long bars low and short bars high, quantised to a major pentatonic, and its colour comes from that same pitch — so the board is legible as music before you hear it, and a machine that maximises bounces is composing. Rendered in three.js through a real bloom pass, with every voice running through a generated convolution reverb, a ping-pong delay and a master limiter. Spend what you make on a brighter, faster, better-paying ball, or on another ball entirely.
